description: The constructor enforces its stated paired-normalization invariant only when Q normalization is present.
trigger: Construct Attention with q_norm=None and a non-null k_norm.
expected_behavior: Reject the incomplete pair consistently with the assertion message requiring both norms or neither.
actual_behavior: The else branch sets both attributes to None, silently discarding the supplied K norm. No inspected in-tree builder supplies either new argument, so the observed reach is the new constructor interface rather than an existing model workflow.

verification.description: Compared both constructor branches and inspected all seven direct construction sites found by whole-parent search.
verification.limits: No Attention object was instantiated; external and dynamic callers were not established.
